  Regular Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, May 28, 2024  7:00 PM  Council Chamber

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's web
  site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP -TV
  Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  A.  PALOS VERDES PENINSULA HIGH SCHOOL KICK ASH

3.  ROLL CALL

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the
  City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member
  prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on separately.)

  A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the
  City Council will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read by
  title only.
  B.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS OF MAY 2024
  Recommendation: Approve warrants 67341 through 67412 in the amount of
  $392,752.38, and Supplemental Warrants 050424 through 050624 in the amount of
  $124,008.95; for a grand total amount of $516,760.83 with proper audit.
  Attachments: Demands & Warrants

  C.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS REPORT OF APRIL 2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  D.  REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE REPORT OF APRIL 2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  E.  BUDGET AMENDMENTS FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Budget Amendments for Fiscal
  Year 2023-2024.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  F.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF MAY 14, 2024
  Recommendation: Review and approve.
  Attachments: Draft Minutes

  G.  PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES OF MAY 6, 2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Minutes

  H.  PALOS VERDES PENINSULA PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE AND
  REGIONAL CONTRACT LAW COMMITTEE MINUTES OF FEBRUARY 1,
  2024
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Peninsula Public Safety Committee Minutes

  Regional Contract Law Committee Draft Minutes

6.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS
  This is the appropriate time for members of the public to make comments regarding items not listed on this
  agenda. If you would like to address the City Council, please complete a speaker sheet and give to the
  City Clerk. Under the State's open meeting law - the Brown Act - no action may be taken on any item not
  on the agenda.

  A.  WASTE MANAGEMENT "RECYCLING HERO" DRAWING FOR ONE YEAR
  OF FREE RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE SERVICE - 2ND
  QUARTER 2024

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  NONE

8.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  WASTE MANAGEMENT REQUEST FOR RATE ADJUSTMENTS

  Memorandum from Alexa Davis, Assistant City Manager and Gabrielle Swain,
  Administrative Aide
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve Waste Management’s request for a
  rate adjustment on all levels of service as included in the attached FY 2024-25
  Collection Service Rate Schedule effective July 1, 2024.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  B.  PROJECT LIST FOR SB 1 FUND ELIGIBILITY; FISCAL YEAR 2024-25
  (RESOLUTION NO. 2570)
  Memorandum from David Wahba, Public Works Director
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve Resolution No. 2570, adopting a
  list of projects for Fiscal Year 2024-25 funded by SB 1, the Road Repair and
  Accountability Act of 2017.
  Attachments: Staff Report + Resolution No. 2570

  C.  MASTER PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT (MPSA) WITH HDR
  ENGINEERING INCORPORATED FOR THE PETER WEBER EQUESTRIAN
  CENTER (PWEC) RESTROOM PROJECT
  Memorandum from David Wahba, Public Works Director
  Recommendation: That the City Council Approve a 1) Master Professional Services
  Agreement (MPSA) with HDR Engineering Incorporated, and 2) Task Order No.
  1-2024, under the MPSA in the amount of $25,000.
  Attachments: Staff Report

9.  OLD BUSINESS

  NONE

10.  CITY ATTORNEY ITEMS

11.  CITY COUNCIL / REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS
  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to provide information and reports to
  other Members of the City Council and the public on any issues or activities of Council Committees, ad
  hoc committees, regional or state-wide governmental associations, special districts, joint powers
  authorities and the various committees on which Members of the City Council might serve or have an
  interest, which are not otherwise agendized.

12.  MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS
  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to request information on currently
  pending projects and/or issues of public concern, direct that an item be agendized for future consideration
  and/or make announcements of interest to the public.

13.  CLOSED SESSION
  If you would like to address the City Council regarding an item on the Closed Session agenda, please
  contact the City Manager or City Clerk. Any reportable action taken in Closed Session will be reported
  in Open Session.

  NONE

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Next meeting: June 11, 2024
